title: Seveneves
author: Neal Stephenson
summary: The Moon breaks apart without warning, and scientists realise that Earth has only two years before a rain of debris ends life on the surface. Humanity builds a desperate plan in orbit, and the book then leaps far ahead.
readIf: you like engineering-heavy science fiction with a huge sweep and a lot of detail on how survival works.
skipIf: you dislike long technical explanations or want character moments over problem-solving.

pairings.reason: Equally devoted to solving survival problems step by step, with far more humour and a single hero.
A warmer story with the same love of clever science and a huge stake for the human race.
A gentler, more literary view of what survives after civilisation ends.
